import pandas as pd

def transform_source_to_target(source_path):
    """
    Load a source CSV file, extract the V_GENE from the J_CALL column,
    and return a DataFrame with the target schema.
    """
    # Load source data
    df_source = pd.read_csv(source_path)
    
    # Extract V_GENE by splitting on '*' and taking the first part
    df_source['V_GENE'] = df_source['J_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]
    
    # Select only the target column
    df_target = df_source[['V_GENE']]
    
    return df_target

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_paths = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, they would be listed here
    ]
    
    # Transform each source and collect results
    transformed_dfs = []
    for path in source_paths:
        df_transformed = transform_source_to_target(path)
        transformed_dfs.append(df_transformed)
    
    # Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
    df_final = pd.concat(transformed_dfs, ignore_index=True)
    
    # Write the final DataFrame to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
